# Smarter patents, smarter strategy: How AI analytics and legal finance are changing corporate IP monetization


- Patent & IP


June 11, 2026


**Katharine Wolanyk**


## Summary


Patent portfolios often contain significant untapped value. As AI-powered analytics make it easier to identify high-potential assets and legal finance expands monetization options, companies are adopting more strategic approaches to licensing, enforcement and portfolio management to unlock value from intellectual property.
